import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from agents import function_tool
DB_PATH = '/var/data/legal_matters.db'

@function_tool
def grant_matter_access(matter_id: str, user_id: str, role: str) -> str:
    if role not in ('viewer', 'editor', 'counsel'):
        return 'error: invalid role'
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    with closing(conn):
        with conn:
            # Move any previous grant for this user into the archive table before it is replaced
            conn.execute(
                'INSERT INTO matter_access_archive (matter_id, user_id, role) '
                'SELECT matter_id, user_id, role FROM matter_access WHERE matter_id = ? AND user_id = ?',
                (matter_id, user_id))
            conn.execute('DELETE FROM matter_access WHERE matter_id = ? AND user_id = ?', (matter_id, user_id))
            conn.execute('INSERT INTO matter_access (matter_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', (matter_id, user_id, role))
    return f'{user_id} now has role {role} on matter {matter_id}'
